title: Lift Jesus higher

lines.text: Lift Him up for the world to see.
He said, if I be lifted up from the earth,
I will draw all men unto Me.

chords:

lyrics:
[Verse]
Lift Jesus higher,
Lift Jesus higher,
Lift Him up for the world to see.
He said, if I be lifted up from the earth,
I will draw all men unto Me.
